rows.text: ICRA **upgrades its bank facilities to [ICRA]A (Positive) from [ICRA]A- (Stable)** and raises the rated amount to Rs 214.95 crore from Rs 113.50 crore, citing 24% and 61% revenue growth in FY25 and FY26.
India Ratings **upgrades its bank-loan facilities to IND A/Stable**, affirming the short-term rating at IND A1 and assigning the same to a further INR 1,018.6 million of facilities.
